target.statement: HOLLMWOOD wins 57.8% of pairwise comparisons against Plan-then-Write on Overall Quality using GPT-3.5 as backbone

compute.basis: The target requires generating 60 full screenplays with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, then evaluating them with GPT-4; no code or data is released, and the API cost alone is prohibitive.

blockers: Requires extensive API calls to GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 (estimated cost >$300)
Evaluation depends on GPT-4 as a judge, which is a closed model
Generating 60 screenplays with multiple steps and baselines is time-consuming and not feasible within a few hours on a laptop
title: HoLLMwood: Unleashing the Creativity of Large Language Models in Screenwriting via Role Playing
